title: Truthful and kind replies; self-assessment chart
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y5 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: truthful and kind replies; self-assessment chart)
intro: Lesson 21: Truthful speech. To understand why Islam commands truthful speech and how truthfulness leads to goodness

questions.q: Explain what the hadith teaches about truthfulness.
questions.a: Truthfulness leads to righteousness and Paradise; lying leads to wickedness.
questions.model: Point: truth leads to good. Evidence: 'Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise' (Bukhari and Muslim). Explain: each true word builds a good habit.

questions.q: Scenario cards on the pupil PDF: for four situations (a broken vase, a gift you dislike, homework not done, a friend's drawing), write a truthful and kind reply.
questions.a: True, gentle replies for each, for example: 'I broke it by accident, I am sorry'
questions.model: Teacher does card 1: 'I broke the vase by accident. I am sorry, can I help clear it up?'

questions.q: why is exaggerating a kind of lie?
questions.a: It makes something sound untrue, so it is not fully truthful

questions.q: why do people trust a truthful person?
questions.a: Their words match the facts every time

questions.q: Back to our ponder: small lie or kind truth?
questions.a: Kind truth: gentle words that are still true
